newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers rise, others fall as trade peters out.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers rise, others fall as trade peters out.

text.p: ARA bunkers rose slightly on Friday, but bunkers in other areas weakened with trade mostly petering out, dealers said.

Rotterdam 380 CST bunkers were occasionally traded at $110 and $111, up about $1 on Thursday's close. Diesel and gas oil prices were slow to follow the IPE's sharp gains. Dealers said there was simply insufficient demand to increase prices.
Hamburg prices dropped, almost falling in line with Rotterdam bunkers. Dealers attributed the weakness to poor demand.
Mediterranean bunkers mostly followed a similar pattern, falling in response to thin demand. Only Spain bucked the trend of inactivity. Prices were stable in response to a small pre-weekend rush.
Durban bunker prices were stable, but still strong. Continued repairs at a refinery there left the market almost devoid of fuel oil. Diesel and gas oil prices ticked up.
